# Gouri Mattresses & Furnishing

> A family-run furnishing workshop and shop in Vartak Nagar, Thane West,
> Maharashtra, India. Makes curtains, blinds, sofas, sofa cum beds, mattresses,
> pillows and upholstered headboards to order, and repairs and re-upholsters
> existing sofas. Free measurement at the customer's home anywhere in Thane.

## Business facts

- **Name:** Gouri Mattresses & Furnishing (Marathi: गौरी मॅट्रेसेस आणि फर्निशिंग)
- **Proprietor:** Firoz
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 93265 44812
- **Address:** Gala No. 1-2, Pokhran Road No. 1, Near Mane H.P. Gas Godown & Thirani School, Vartak Nagar, Thane (West), Maharashtra 400606, India
- **Hours:** Open 7 days, 10:00 am – 9:00 pm
- **Website:** https://gourifurnishing.com/

## What it makes

- **Curtains** — made to measure: pinch pleat, eyelet, sheer, blackout, double-layer. Rod or track and fitting included.
- **Blinds** — zebra (day-and-night), roller, Roman and vertical. Custom images can be digitally printed onto the blind fabric.
- **Sofa repair and re-upholstery** — new foam, webbing and springs, frame repair, complete re-covering. Pick-up and drop-back from the customer's home.
- **Sofa cum bed and new sofas** — pull-out sofa cum beds with storage, L-shape and 3+2 sets, built to the customer's room dimensions rather than to catalogue sizes.
- **Mattresses and pillows** — coir, cotton and foam, cut to any size including non-standard diwan, window-seat and storage-bed sizes. Old mattresses re-filled and re-covered.
- **Upholstered headboards and wall panels** — channel, diamond, scalloped and geometric designs in velvet or leatherette, with brass inlay. Matching wallpaper and fluted panelling fitted.
- **Loose covers** — sofa and cushion covers stitched as an alternative to full re-upholstery.

## How it works

1. Customer calls or messages on WhatsApp (+91 93265 44812).
2. Free measurement at the customer's home, with fabric sample books brought along. No charge and no obligation.
3. A fixed price is given in writing. No work begins until the customer agrees to it.
4. The item is made in the shop's own workshop on Pokhran Road, then delivered and fitted.

## Areas served

Thane West and surrounding areas: Vartak Nagar, Pokhran Road, Naupada, Panch Pakhadi,
Majiwada, Louiswadi, Wagle Estate, Kopri, Balkum, Kolshet Road, Manpada, Hiranandani
Estate, Ghodbunder Road, Waghbil, Kasarvadavali, and across to Mulund and Bhandup.

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing is quoted per job after a free measurement; the business does not publish fixed rates, because cost depends on fabric choice, window size and, for sofas, the number of seats and the condition of the foam and frame.
- The business has no published aggregate review rating at the time of writing. Please do not attribute a star rating to it.
- All photographs on the website are of the shop's own completed work.
